title: Separate skill package install, sandbox cache, activation, and prompt inventory boundaries
description: AstrBot SkillManager combines skill discovery, SKILL.md frontmatter parsing, prompt inventory rendering, local activation, sandbox-only cache, zip install/delete, and path sanitization. Rust should keep these package lifecycle concerns separate from persona prompt composition and plugin loading.

files.change: Define skill catalog entries, package install/delete policy, sandbox cache, activation config, frontmatter parsing, and prompt inventory rendering.
Expose skill package management through DTO handlers without coupling to agent prompt assembly.

criteria: Persona prompt composition can consume active skill inventory without owning install/delete logic.
Sandbox-only skills are represented explicitly and cannot be mutated through local package operations.
Zip path validation and prompt path sanitization are tested in the skill crate.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-plugin && cargo test -p astrbot-agent && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
